summary: Frontend-only validation completed for Startup Toolkit and Business Plan Generator on public URL. Core routing, guided sections, live preview updates, DOCX/PDF downloads, and mobile usability passed. One requirement gap found: preview lacks explicit SWOT heading text.

integration_issues.issue: Competitive Analysis page renders SWOT content grid but does not show explicit 'SWOT' heading text in preview, which can fail strict template expectation for a named SWOT section.

action_items: Add an explicit SWOT heading in BusinessPlanPreview page 06 (before SWOT cards) to satisfy named-section requirement.
Optionally add a dedicated data-testid for SWOT heading for stable UI regression assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: BusinessPlanPreview uses label values ('01'..'10') inside test IDs (e.g., business-plan-page-06), which is workable but brittle; semantic IDs per section name would improve long-term test maintainability.
The first Playwright run failed live-preview check due selector mismatch in test script, highlighting the importance of strict reuse of existing data-testid naming convention in forms.jsx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: desktop nav has Startup Toolkit; /startup home loads and card/CTA routing works; /startup/business-plan-generator loads; section menu buttons work; company name edits instantly update cover preview; DOCX and PDF downloads trigger successfully; mobile nav includes Startup Toolkit and generator has no page-level horizontal overflow at 390x844. Remaining gap: no explicit SWOT heading text in preview page.
